versions.changelog:
onboard 1.0.0

- Initial release introducing a focused onboarding flow for Codex, activated only via `/onboard`.
- Guides users through a lightweight interview to gather name and work context using clear, one-at-a-time questions.
- Strictly enforces allowed tools and boundaries for onboarding: only AskQuestion, cursor_dialog, and SwitchMode are permitted.
- Automatically saves onboarding details to a single "User onboarding preferences" rule, unless the user opts out or the functionality is unavailable.
- Directs users to pick a first goal and routes them to relevant next steps or handoff actions, maintaining concise and actionable guidance throughout onboarding.
